load_data_split: load a 3-fold train/val/test data split from a TensorFlow dataset like MNIST for conformal prediction
create_data_split: create a 3-fold train/val/test data split from a dataset that has only a single train split
load_batches: iterate over batched TensorFlow datasets and yield JAX arrays of images and labels
augment_flip_crop: apply random flip and crop augmentation to a batch of images for CIFAR10 training
augment_autoaugment: apply AutoAugment policy augmentation to a batch of images for CIFAR10 training
